risks: From the start of this financial year, geopolitical uncertainties have led to renewed commodity inflation, creating near-term pressure on margins.

We are actively mitigating this impact through customer engagements, value engineering, localization, and cost productivity measures, and expect the pressure to moderate as recoveries progressively flow through.
focus: We will continue to focus on recovering commodity inflation, improving contribution margins, increasing productivity, and maintaining a discipline on fixed costs.

We remain focused on improving the performance of our overseas businesses through higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and conversion of the recently secured programs into revenues.
Our continuous focus on technology and intellectual property is also showing results, with the company having filed more than 140 patents so far.

about: Varroc Engineering Ltd was incorporated in 1988, is the flagship company of the Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar-based Varroc Group. Varroc is a global tier-1 automotive component group.
